_meta.description: Complaint/demand/dispute templates for South Africa. Legal basis, addressee, and framing are FIXED here (not AI-generated). The generator fills only the {{fact}} slots with the user's details. Redact by default. Not legal advice.

popia_complaint.title: POPIA complaint (Information Regulator)
popia_complaint.legal_basis: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA).
popia_complaint.not_advice: This is a self-prepared complaint, not legal advice. Verify details and the current complaint form (Form 5) before filing.

ncr_complaint.title: Complaint to the National Credit Regulator
ncr_complaint.legal_basis: National Credit Act 34 of 2005 (registration, reckless-credit and enforcement provisions).
ncr_complaint.not_advice: This is a self-prepared complaint, not legal advice.

bureau_dispute.title: Credit bureau listing dispute
bureau_dispute.legal_basis: National Credit Act 34 of 2005 and POPIA (right to accurate credit information; right to dispute).
bureau_dispute.not_advice: This is a self-prepared dispute, not legal advice.

cease_contact_letter.title: Stop-contact / cease-and-desist letter (to the lender)
cease_contact_letter.legal_basis: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA): lawful, fair, non-excessive processing; the data subject's right to object (s.11(3)). Abusive collection contact and contacting third parties in your phonebook can be unlawful processing.
cease_contact_letter.not_advice: This is a self-prepared letter you send directly to the lender, not legal advice. Keep proof that you sent it (screenshot, delivery receipt). It demands they stop; it does not by itself make them stop.

small_claims_statement.title: Letter of demand / claim: Small Claims Court
small_claims_statement.addressee: The Small Claims Court (via a letter of demand first)
small_claims_statement.legal_basis: Small Claims Courts Act 61 of 1984. A letter of demand is required before lodging; you represent yourself (no advocate).
small_claims_statement.body:
LETTER OF DEMAND

To {{lender_name}},

I, {{redacted_name}}, demand payment of R {{claim_amount}}.

The claim arises as follows: on {{dates}}, {{what_happened}}.
The amount is calculated as: {{claim_basis}}.

Unless payment is made within 14 days of this letter, I will lodge a claim against you in the Small Claims Court, where I am entitled to appear in person without an attorney.

Evidence I hold: {{evidence_list}}.

Case reference (my record): {{case_ref}}
Contact: {{redacted_contact}}

Dated: ______________
{{redacted_name}}
small_claims_statement.not_advice: This is a self-prepared letter of demand, not legal advice. Confirm the current Small Claims Court monetary limit, your nearest court, and the required procedure before lodging. A letter of demand must be sent before you can lodge.
